description.en: Canadia-inspired flattened elongate annelid with grouped overlapping broad dorsal chaetae, widest/longest near the midline, and two smooth anterior tentacles. Fine chaetal teeth, gills and segment counts simplified, no fine-spike noise coat.
description.zh: Canadia启发扁长环节动物，成组叠覆宽叶状背刚毛靠中线较长较宽，具两根光滑头须。微细锯齿、鳃和体节数量简化，不以细刺噪声覆盖。

artistic_choices.en: Nominal dimensions, original palette, exact repeated-feature counts and static pose are artistic. No strict species, specimen-copy, locomotion, animation or coexistence reconstruction.
artistic_choices.zh: 名义尺度、原创配色、重复结构数量及静态姿态属美术选择。不作严格种级复原、标本复制、运动机制、动画或共存复原承诺。

structural_scope.en: Slightly flattened continuous worm body with overlapping groups of broad dorsal chaetae and exactly two smooth anterior tentacles. Fine serrations, gills and exact segment counts simplified; nominal body length excludes tentacles.
structural_scope.zh: 轻度背腹扁连续虫体，成组叠覆宽背刚毛与两条平滑头须；省简微观锯齿、鳃及精确节数，名义体长不计须。
